definitions.gloss: rice washing; rinsing rice before cooking
definitions.explanation: The process of washing uncooked rice with water to remove starch, bran, and impurities before cooking. An essential step in preparing Japanese rice.

examples.japanese: {米研|こめと}ぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ。
examples.english: Washing rice is a daily task.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{米研|こめと}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the children help with washing the rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{米研|こめと}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなくて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: These days there is no-wash rice, so you don't have to wash the rice.

notes: Compound of ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (uncooked rice) + {研|と}ぎ (polishing/washing, from ⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧). The traditional method involves swirling rice in water and draining it several times until the water runs clear. The water left from washing rice ({研|と}ぎ{汁|じる}) has traditionally been reused for watering plants or as a cooking stock. ⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧ (pre-washed/no-rinse rice) has become popular as a time-saving alternative.
